name: qpack
description: QPack - 极简、高性能、跨平台解压缩工具

scripts.build:dmg: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY="$HOME/.tauri/qpack.key" TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD="" pnpm tauri build --bundles app && python3 -m dmgbuild -s scripts/dmg-settings.py QPack src-tauri/target/release/bundle/dmg/QPack_0.1.7_aarch64.dmg
scripts.build:win: TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY="$HOME/.tauri/qpack.key" TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD="" PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm@21/bin:$PATH" pnpm tauri build --runner cargo-xwin --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
